samples.xml_description:
<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
    <description>Multiplies two 4-bit numbers using pipelining technique. Multiplier is stored in mul_reg[0] and multiplicand is stored in mul_reg[1]. Registers mul_reg[2], mul_reg[3] and mul_reg[4] are used for storing partial sums generated during the multiplication process. Final product is stored in mul_out.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset input.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier operand A.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Multiplier operand B.</input>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="size">Number of bits in operands.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="add_in" width_description="[2*size:0]">Intermediate sum value for addition stage.</signal>
        <signal id="i">Loop variable.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="mul_reg" width_description="[4:0][2*size+1:0]">Register array for storing intermediate values.</signal>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        Extends the inputs by appending "size" zeros to their most significant bit positions. Calculates the product of two 4-bit numbers using pipelined stages. Each stage adds a partial product to the accumulated result. The final product is obtained after accumulating all the partial products.
        
        Sequential logic: 
            On positive edge of the clock or negative edge of the reset signal, updates the register array with the intermediate sum values for each stage. Also resets the register array if the reset signal is active.
            
        Combinational logic:
            Generates the intermediate sum values based on the partial products. Adds the current stage's sum to the next stage's input.
        
        Inputs:
            clk: Clock input.
            rst_n: Reset input.
            mul_a: Multiplicand input.
            mul_b: Multiplier input.
            
        Outputs:
            mul_out: Product output.
        
        Internal signals:
            mul_reg: Register array for storing intermediate values.
            add_in: Intermediate sum value for addition stage.
            i: Loop variable.
        
        Parameters:
            size: Number of bits in operands.
    </implementation>
</module>
